_comment: Single source of truth for local-LLM model lineups across every machine, Linux/Mac (ik-llama/*.sh) and Windows/ProBook (llm/*.ps1) alike. Each script reads this instead of keeping its own list or scraping another script's source text. Edit this file to add/change a model; do not hardcode one in a script. Retired/historical ProBook modes stay as a comment block in llm/start-llm.ps1 (recipe to restore, not live data) rather than cluttering this file with entries nothing on disk backs.

_fields.desc: Human-readable label, shown in the interactive menu
_fields.file: Local GGUF filename -- this is the model id used everywhere (OpenCode/Pi provider keys, llama-swap model names, etc.)
_fields.cram: Prompt-cache RAM limit (MB) passed to -cram (ik_llama.cpp only; ignored by mainline llama.cpp)
_fields.yarn: Apply the machine's YARN rope-scaling flags
_fields.sample: Apply the machine's SAMPLE_BASE sampling flags (--temp/--top-p/--top-k)
_fields.spec: Raw --spec-type speculative-decoding flags, or null (honoured on every machine, ProBook included)
_fields.chat_template: Needs qwen3-template.j2 (models whose built-in template doesn't handle tool calling well)
_fields.mmproj: Vision projector: {file, repo, repo_file, bytes} or null. repo_file is the filename on HuggingFace when it differs from the local file name.
_fields.download: {repo, repo_file, bytes} for download-models.sh. bytes is null where the exact size hasn't been pinned (not verified on download).
_fields.engine: probook only: 'mainline' or 'ik_llama' -- start-llm.ps1 runs both engines on that machine and the mode table has to say which
_fields.short: probook only: the short mode name (e.g. 'qwen36u35b_ml') used as the OpenCode/mode id there, distinct from the GGUF stem. i9/Mac use the GGUF stem itself as the id, so they don't need this field.

i9.desc: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MTP UD-Q6_K (speculative: suffix + MTP, ~2x on edits)
Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MTP UD-Q5_K_XL, 256K ctx (dynamic quant, matches a colleague's setup; unverified quality vs Q6_K)

probook.desc: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B IQ4_NL (bartowski, vanilla) on mainline, draft-mtp from its embedded MTP layers
